note: The contributions push is an owned per-instance unit, not a projection of one refreshUi. Every scenario below drives refreshes that supersede one another while the guest document read is still pending; the push must still land exactly once per (instanceId, content).

scenarios.note: The live defect: a guest re-arming a faulting flowEvalTick settles into a new refresh every few seconds, so every refresh that started a push was superseded while the document read was still in flight.
Once installed, later refreshes must not re-push the same content into the same instance.
A push whose session went away must be abandoned, never installed into an instance nobody is looking at. The next session resolves its own scope and installs under its own key.
A genesis document with no example fallback resolves no operator kinds; the unit reports the reason instead of pushing an unscoped closure.
